analysis.title: GE Vernova (GEV): 3Q26 First Take: Large Power driven beat, orders robust
key_insights: GEV 3Q26 segment EBITDA was $2,108mn, +15% vs GS ($1,827mn) and +16% vs consensus ($1,810mn). The beat was driven largely by Power, with a 21.4% margin vs GS 18.4% and consensus 18.1%.

Total orders were $29bn, +96% organic. Power orders were +178% y/y organically and Power equipment orders were $18bn, +304% organically. GS expects the equipment orders and the pricing flowing through the P&L to be a focus today.
Backlog plus slot reservation agreements (SRAs) is 122GW, +6GW q/q. GEV raised its full-year guide to >130GW, vs 125GW prior and 100GW at the start of the year.
The mix of the backlog is positive: 64GW in orders (vs 53GW in 2Q) and 58GW in SRAs (vs 63GW in 2Q). Equipment orders were $1,083 per kW.

GEV raised its FY26 revenue guide to $46.5-$47.5bn (from $45.5-$46.5bn, vs GS/consensus $46.3bn/$46.3bn). Adjusted EBITDA margin guide was raised to 13.5%-14.5% from 12-14%, and FCF is now expected at $16-$17bn vs $11.5-$12.5bn prior.
The raised guide implies 4Q Power margins above 25% at the high end of the range, which GS calls encouraging.
GEV announced the acquisition of Trench Group for $9bn and raised its buyback authorization by $10bn.
Total 3Q26 organic growth was +18% vs GS +11.3%. By segment: Power +25% (GS +19%), Wind +3% (GS -13.7%), Electrification +16% (GS +22.8%).
Electrification revenue of $3,862mn missed GS ($3,983mn) by 3.0% and EBITDA of $739mn missed GS ($761mn) by 2.9%, on a 19.1% margin in line with GS.
Adjusted EPS (diluted) was $4.81 vs GS $3.78 and FactSet $4.01. Wind EBITDA was $72mn vs GS $2mn.
GS rates GEV Buy with a 12-month price target of $1,224 (27.0x Q5-Q8 EBITDA) vs a $895.08 price, 36.7% upside. GS views the result as strong all around and expects the shares to outperform.

market_movers.rationale: Large Power driven EBITDA beat, robust orders, raised FY26 guidance. GS expects the shares to outperform.
